draw_a.when: VCC = 5 V, CE high, BAT suspended (TJ = 25 C); no figure is given while charging, and no maximum

power.note: Charging range: charging starts above the VCC threshold, 4.0 V typical rising (3.9 V falling), and stops above the input overvoltage protection, 6.5 V typical (Table 4 p.4). Neither has a tolerance; VCC operation voltage is given only as 5 V typical. The chip withstands 4-24 V at its input (Features p.1) and 28 V absolute maximum (Table 3.1 p.3), but does not charge above VOVP. With CE low it draws 40 uA typ (Table 4 p.4)

VCC.note: Charger input (USB VBUS). Starts charging above the 4.0 V typical rising threshold (3.9 V falling), stops above the 6.5 V typical input overvoltage protection; withstands 24 V in operation and 28 V absolute maximum (surge). 150 uA quiescent with CE high. Bypass to GND with a ceramic capacitor of at least 10 uF effective value, as close as possible

citation.locator: Features p.1; Table 3.1 and Table 3.2 p.3; Table 4 p.4

enable.note: High enables charging, low shuts it down; the datasheet says connect it to VCC or an MCU and gives no default for an open pin (Table 3.2 p.3). The package circuit ties it to VCC

power.note: LGS4056HDA, 4.20 V. v_out: VCV 4.20 V typical at TJ = 25 C, with no tolerance printed (Table 4 p.4); Figure 9.e (p.10) plots a typical 4.19-4.21 V over temperature, not a limit, so it is not used. i_max_a is the charge current this circuit programs: below 300 mA I_BAT = 900 / R_PROG (mA, kohm; Table 3.2 p.3, Set Output Current p.7) with the package circuit's 18 kohm = 900 / 18 = 50 mA; the datasheet tabulates only 1-9 kohm (Table 4 p.4) and gives no tolerance. Below regulation the PMOS pass device's RDS(ON) is 1200 mOhm typical, no maximum (Table 4 p.4); p.7 says 1 A charging needs more than 1.2 V of input-output difference. It stops below the VCC falling threshold, 3.9 V typical (Table 4 p.4). No theta_ja is given for any package; the over-temperature protection is at TJ 150 C typ (Table 4 p.4) and the features quote a -40 to 85 C junction range (p.1) against an operating temperature of -40 to 125 C (Table 3.1 p.3), so no tj_max is given here. Linear: no efficiency figure. No separate iq_a: the chip's draw is on VCC

BAT.note: Battery charge output, to the cell's positive terminal. Regulates to 4.20 V (VCV, typical at TJ = 25 C; no tolerance is printed, Figure 9.e plots 4.19-4.21 V over -50..150 C). Absolute maximum 6 V. Less than 1 uA drawn from the cell with VCC at 0 V. Ceramic capacitor of at least 10 uF effective value to GND

GND.note: Chip ground (pin 3) and the exposed pad (9), which can be joined to GND and to a large copper plane for heat

PROG.note: Charge current set and monitor: a 1 % resistor RPROG to GND. I_BAT = 1000 / R_PROG above 300 mA, I_BAT = 900 / R_PROG below 300 mA (mA, kohm; i.e. (VPROG / RPROG) x 1000 or x 900, with VPROG 1 V in constant current). 1 k = 1 A, 2 k = 0.5 A, 9 k = 0.1 A. Floating PROG (RPROG removed) shuts the charger down. Absolute maximum 6 V. High impedance: keep the RPROG trace short

TEMP.note: Battery NTC input: charging is suspended while TEMP is below 45 % or above 80 % of VCC. Grounded or floating disables the temperature check; the datasheet asks for it grounded when the NTC is not used. With an NTC divider from VCC, keep more than 10 kohm between VCC and TEMP. Absolute maximum 6 V

CE.note: Charge enable: high enables charging, low shuts down (40 uA from VCC, < 1 uA from the cell). Tie to VCC or drive from an MCU. Schmitt input, thresholds 1.37 V rising / 1.16 V falling (typical); absolute maximum 28 V

levels.note: Typical thresholds (Table 4 gives no min or max); they do not scale with VCC. Absolute maximum 28 V to GND

STATUS.note: Open-drain charge status outputs, active low. CHRG low while charging; DONE low when charge is complete; with no battery CHRG blinks and DONE is low; both off (high impedance) in undervoltage or with the battery too hot or cold. 5 mA LED drive current (typical). Made for an LED cathode with a resistor (1 kohm or more) from VCC; a pull-up to another rail must not pulse while VCC powers up, and DONE must not see a pulse then. An unused one is grounded. Absolute maximum 28 V to GND
